name: A Great Hunger
source:
Having grown tired and fearful of the life she had been forced into, Amelia tries to find some sense of solace in the few moments she spends with another captive of the castle: A demon she has chosen to name Kuro. She struggles to be at peace with herself as she is dealt harsh lashings from all sides, not knowing who else to turn to.

But one night, as if having heard her silent pleas and desperate wish, the demon offers her a terrifying proposal: to kill the man she once loved.

[From [url=https://goldieclaws.itch.io/a-great-hunger]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿米莉亚对被迫过的生活感到厌倦和恐惧，她试图在与城堡中的另一个俘虏（她选择命名为库洛的恶魔）度过的短暂时光中找到一些安慰。当她受到来自各方的严厉鞭打时，她努力让自己平静下来，不知道还能向谁求助。

但有一天晚上，仿佛听到了她无声的恳求和绝望的愿望，恶魔向她提出了一个可怕的建议：杀死她曾经爱过的男人。

[来自[url=https://goldieclaws.itch.io/a-great-hunger]itch.io[/url]]
